svg.text: Only the five things research shows help older adults take medicine. Everything else removed.
One cue at the routine moment
1 Tie each dose to a daily routine: "after breakfast" (implementation intentions, routine anchoring)
2 Show the exact compartment: taking from the wrong compartment is the most common organizer error
3 Confirm with the time it was opened: removes "did I take it?" (missed and double doses)
4 One timely cue, then one more: digital reminders work, and brief cues respect attention
5 Family only on a miss: caregiver support improves adherence
